claims.enumeration: The implementation enumerates every subset exactly once in deterministic cardinality-then-declared-order order.
claims.failure_handling: Failed or missing observations are not converted to objective values and invalidate complete-landscape analysis.
analysis_families: oracle-assisted Greedy ADD and Random Search replay

test_fixture_contracts: missing, duplicate, and failed observation rejection
interpretation_boundary: Synthetic tests validate analysis logic only; they provide no evidence about PostgreSQL, Advisor behavior, or the empirical set function.
